name: Sentinel of Nova Kai
summary: A sentinel whose answer hits far harder with the right Object, and who stays on guard.

face.name: Sentinel of Nova Kai
face.flavor: The answering blow is the only one it has always prepared.

effect.text: If this Entity has an Object assigned, its Counterattack becomes +2.

vigil.text: The first time each of your turns this Entity attacks while it has an Object assigned, untap it after combat.
